indexableObject.name: THE PROBATE AND ADMINISTRATION OF ESTATES ACT

dc.contributor.author.value: OFFICE OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL, OAG

dc.description.abstract.value:
An Act to provide for the grant of probates of wills and letters of administration to the estates of deceased persons, to make certain 
provisions with regard to the powers and duties of executors and administrators; administration of wakf property; benevolent payments in Islamic estates, and related matters.
